name: Password Sign-In Endpoint
summary: Maps the stable anonymous password-login REST contract to the normalized authentication flow boundary.
projectionNotes: The generated route and request/response contracts remain unchanged. The REST controller delegates to IAuthenticationFlowService.LoginWithPasswordAsync and does not select canonical outcomes itself.

The stable AuthenticationResponse contract carries AuthenticationState=MfaRequired and provider=totp for the second-factor handoff; redirectPage is not required to encode the canonical AuthView destination.

sourceReferences.note: POST endpoint delegates to the stable authentication flow service.
Application front door validates all four emitted Password Sign In transitions.
